# SYQORA NEXUS — Digital Technology Studio

> SYQORA NEXUS is an elite digital engineering and technology studio founded by Shubham Sonkusare (Full-Stack Engineer & ML Researcher) and Yamini Nandanwar (Data Analyst & AI Solutions Lead). The studio specializes in high-performance bespoke web applications, enterprise business systems, luxury salon/gym digital platforms, AI-driven automation, and interactive analytics dashboards.

## Core Services

- [Custom Web Engineering](https://syqora-nexus.netlify.app/#services): Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind web applications built for sub-second page loads, 100/100 Core Web Vitals, and conversion optimization.
- [AI & Machine Learning Solutions](https://syqora-nexus.netlify.app/#services): Intelligent feature integration, heuristic classification testbeds, predictive algorithms, and custom workflow automations.
- [Enterprise Business Intelligence](https://syqora-nexus.netlify.app/#services): SQL data modeling, Power BI interactive reporting, KPI dashboards, and data-driven executive analytics.
- [Luxury & Boutique Digital Platforms](https://syqora-nexus.netlify.app/#services): High-end digital experiences with WhatsApp booking pipelines, multi-location management, and automated lead capture.

- [Homepage & Overview](https://syqora-nexus.netlify.app/): Main studio portal showcasing interactive technology demos, capabilities, and live prototypes.

- [Direct Contact & Inquiries](https://syqora-nexus.netlify.app/#contact): Instant WhatsApp and Gmail direct links for rapid project onboarding.
